Hello!
With 1.1.8 I've added some minor QOL improvements and important updates for the future:
Added Portuguese translation.
Framework has been updated, this should resolve some issues with more recent hardware but the install size will increase by a few MB.
Minor performance improvements from the DLC added to the base game.
You now have the option to 'abandon' your current run
Fixed some really old bugs
Expect more QOL updates in the next few months!

If you have the DLC Void Echoes installed, remember that you have to disable the DLC in the Steam options if you want to play the 'vanilla' game.

The ship is also unlocked by default so you can try it whenever you want.

This patch brings a lot of small changes and balances a lot of small things to improve the early game for new players. It will make the game easier in regular mode and make it more easy to progress in the hardcore mode levels.
Reduced HP for the boss in the first systems
Reduced HP and starting shields for enemies in the first 3 systems
Reduced the card market costs for common cards and many other costs for cards adjusted
Last Resort damage reduced to 20
AI Supremacy nerfed, only spawns 3/3 drones
Special Circumstances now gives more damage to bosses
Kinetic Barrier buffed to 8 damage
Overheated Shields and Beast Mode now have ignite synergy to allow for more card combos
Crippling Ion now deals a bit more damage
Mythic cards will only drop on bosses from the 3rd system onward
That is all for now but more balances and checks are on the horizon.
New patch with some importance fixes, balance changes and new events!
Flux Defluxer was nerfed, and now costs more shield capacity to deal damage and the other option gives less shield capacity

The old Temple Ruins event is now back. It was previously removed because a new temple event was coming soon, but until then, the old one is back on the table. The new redesigned temple ruins event will probably only come in the 1.1 content patch

Other existing events can now appear on the yellow random event mark
Devious Escape is now being scrapped correctly, in both boss and non boss cases
The Void Box card will work correctly when you draw Rocket Rain
The Drone Missile can now be correctly targeted when their intent is attack
The enemy damage on the hardcore mode levels has been reduced from level 3 to 7, and now only caps at level 10. There is still probably more balance changes for the hardcore levels difficulty.
Other minor fixes
The Tempestra achievement should be working now
Restart the Core now correctly deactivates when played
Orbiting Shield Drones was buffed, now gives +4 shield capacity
When you have a dual card option to choose and you skip your turn, the pop up should go away
Hardcore level no longer increases when you win a game in regular mode
Counter Maneuver now works on ships that have the 'ion attack' intent
Now there is always the option to buy fuel on regular stations
The Slot Upgrade equipment card should now appear on your Collection after you get it
That is all for now and thank you for the feedback!

Hello travellers!
In part II of the Metaverse Update new enemy ships and enemy mechanics are introduced.
First the new enemy type, the Missile Cruiser, that launches missile drones that after a couple turns deal a powerful blow to player ships.
There are also new offensive effects that enemy ships can do:
The Ion Attack is a new enemy intent, that completely removes all shields from the player.
Bosses and elite enemies can now have a Cloak buff that lasts only one turn, but you cannot target the enemy ship while cloaked
The Offensive Effect can also create a card hand lock down, locking up to 3 hand cards, counting from the right side, that you cannot play.

items.text: The new Boost mechanic allows you to stack Boost points to use it later.

Hi!
The Rendezvous Update brings new encounters, UI improvements, new cards and equipment.
Other small content updates will also drop in the coming days.

The new Synergy mechanic allows you increase the card effects if you have another card in your hand with the same word in the title or synergy wording. It can also be applied to mechanic names or card rarity:

For example, if you have Plasma Affinity in your hand, the card itself will count as one 'Plasma' card in hand, but if you have another card with 'Plasma' in the name, it will also give the effect on number 2.
With 'uncommon synergy' it counts if you have any uncommon cards in hand and 'Ignite Synergy' applies to all cards with the Ignite mechanic in your hand.

releases.displayName: For The Warp upcoming content and patch

items.text: Hello!
First I would like to thank everyone for the great feedback and support during the launch.
A small update with bug fixes was released today, fixing some of the issue reported in the last couple of days.
The first big content update is coming later this week, with the 3rd playable ship called KD Carrier:
It's a drone carrier ship that has a on-board assembler of attack drones.
While it lacks mounted weapons, it has plenty of offensive power via drone cards and also boasts a larger bay for equipment cards.
The ship is almost ready, it just needs a couple more days for testing and should be available by the end of this week.
